buildCommand: bun run --filter @ronin-dojo/web db:generate && bun run --filter @ronin-dojo/web build
_comment_deploy_unit: BBL (apps/web) Vercel project config — ADR 0034 per-product deploy unit. ignoreCommand inspects the TIP commit's OWN changed files (git diff-tree HEAD — present in Vercel's shallow clone, exact under squash-merge) and FAILS TOWARD BUILD: it skips (exit 0) ONLY when none of these paths changed, and never silently skips on an ambiguous ref. This replaced 'git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD ...', which resolved to exit 0 (=skip) on Vercel's shallow clone and silently un-shipped merged work (FS-0041/FS-0046 class — a deploy gate must fail toward build, ADR 0061). Down-synced from rdd-monorepo per petey-plan-0718-bbl-downsync.md (P2 item 6). Scoped to apps/web + the shared kernel apps/web transpiles (packages — a ui-kit change CAN break BBL, so it must trigger a rebuild) + root install/config (bun.lock, package.json, vercel.json). The 'grep -vE [.]mdx?$' strips markdown from the trigger set: package/app READMEs (packages/*/README.md, apps/web/scripts/fixtures/README.md) are NOT build inputs, so a docs-only edit must NOT deploy BBL (SESSION_0501 — verified both directions: docs-in-packages push -> skip, code push -> deploy). Safe because apps/web has NO MDX/content-collection build pipeline; if one is ever added, revisit the exclusion. Since the ADR 0055 brand-repo fork (Phase C1), apps/web is the ONLY app in this repo — the former apps/baseline, apps/rdd, and clients/* trees live in their own sibling repos. CI: ci.yml/playwright.yml gate apps/web.
ignoreCommand: bash -c '! git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r HEAD | grep -vE "[.]mdx?$" | grep -qE "^(apps/web/|packages/|bun[.]lock|package[.]json|vercel[.]json)"'
